Michael is a 35-year-old freelance graphic designer who lives in Seattle. He is interested in high-quality coffee machines that fit his design aesthetic. He has been researching both standard drip coffee makers and espresso machines. Michael is currently experiencing issues with the delivery of his espresso machine, which was ordered a week ago. The tracking number has not been updated, and the shipping status appears to be stuck. Michael is hosting a small gathering and was planning to showcase the espresso machine, but now he is considering using a standard drip coffee maker or visiting a local coffee house instead. He mentioned that the checkout page provided an estimated delivery time of eleven business days, and he chose regular shipping. He also mentioned that he qualified for free shipping after adding a couple of accessories like the stainless-steel frothing pitcher and some extra filters. Michael is concerned about the process of filing a claim with the carrier if the package is lost or damaged during transit. He wants to know if the company will file the claim on his behalf or if he needs to do it himself. Michael is also interested in knowing if there is a return and exchange policy in place for delayed or lost shipments.
